full_judgment: 45. First information report should lodge soon after the occurrence leaving no scope for consultation and fabrication, the presumption is that it is a truthful account eliminating the possibility of substitution of false implication. On the other hand, the Courts have always viewed first information report with grave suspicion when there has been unexplained delay in giving it and under this situation it can be presumed that the delay in the registration of first information report was caused for the purpose of manipulation of the prosecution story. So that delay of one month 5 days in lodging the first information report is no doubt, inordinate and in absence of any explanation for such inordinate delay, we were not in a position to accept the genuineness of the first information report in question.
